== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Han Solo, Innocent Scoundrel (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-hansoloinnocentscoundrel-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-01-Han_Solo_Innocent_Scoundrel.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, 2012-12-12 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html; same text in the capture of 11 January 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During battle, Han may fire a [Virtual Block 8] blaster twice. Once per turn, if opponent is about to draw a weapon destiny targeting Han, they draw two and you choose one. Immune to attrition < 3 (<4 if armed).”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1281_27</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. The frame is CardMaker's plain Light Side character frame; the printed card's red-tinted frame is not in CardMaker.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
